name: dev.ocean/chrome-devtools
description: Control the owner's real, signed-in Chromium browser (Chrome by default; Brave, Edge, Arc, Vivaldi, Opera or Chromium through `ocean browser use`) through the ocean-browser-mcp package (pinned Chrome DevTools MCP): tabs, navigation, clicks, forms, uploads, screenshots, console and network errors. Reads every open tab and acts inside any signed-in session of the attached browser, for every client wired to it. The browser asks to allow each new connection. The filesystem permission is declared for consent but not enforced at runtime, and the npm package is pinned by version, not by digest.

server.name: dev.ocean/chrome-devtools
server.description: ocean-browser-mcp runs Chrome DevTools MCP 1.12.0 attached to the owner's running Chromium browser, with usage statistics and CrUX lookups off, so page URLs stay on this machine.

packageArguments.name: --userDataDir
packageArguments.description: Profile root of the Chromium browser to attach to; unset attaches to Chrome. Set with `ocean browser use <name|path>`.
